summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K solely to announce the pence sterling amount payable for its interim dividend. The company declared a 4.48 US cents per share interim dividend on 30 July 2026, which converts to 3.29 pence sterling per ordinary share using an exchange rate of GBP1:USD1.3624. The dividend will be paid on 21 September 2026 to shareholders on record as of 14 August 2026. This is a routine foreign private issuer dividend disclosure with no special-situation elements.
